upstream.note: Audited commit from the pre-implementation investigation. The runtime is built from this exact commit; the globally installed dsh (0.1.5-rc.1) is NEVER used.

publishedPackage.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh
publishedPackage.note: Published build of the same release. Not used as the runtime: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs only exports `apply` (Config/apply/inject/name), so applyReadImageTool cannot be imported from the packaged lib. The source checkout keeps the ./src/* export that makes read-image-only registration possible.

provider.note: Literal catalog id deepseek-flash (only image-capable default model); effort `max` serializes as output_config.effort on the Messages protocol.

forbiddenGlobals.note: Runtime tests must not invoke the global dsh; setup-runtime.mjs records both versions and fails closed if the source runtime does not report the pinned version.
